name: SA6 EST
driverConfig: 6BA + 2EST (Sonion custom LF BA ×2 + Knowles mid ×2 + Knowles HF ×2 + Sonion EST ×2)

materials.shell: German Nice-Fit hand-poured UV acrylic resin
materials.cable: Hulk Pro Mini with Q-Lock Plus modular plugs

pros: EST drivers add air and extension to the treble
Dual-system quad crossover for precise control
cons: Higher impedance than pure BA sibling
insight: SA6 EST adds two Sonion electrostatic drivers to the SA6 platform for improved treble extension and air. Reviewers who value high-frequency refinement often praise the sense of openness and detail it brings while retaining the coherent BA foundation of the series.
